overview.zh: 该图说明桌面与 P4 串口协议的帧边界和方向：命令由 FE/LEN/CMD/PAYLOAD/FF 打包，长度与共享协议表核对；回包按不同 packet type 解码。帧构造通过不等于设备执行成功。
overview.en: This graph explains serial frame boundaries and traffic direction between the desktop and P4. Commands are packed as FE/LEN/CMD/PAYLOAD/FF and checked against the shared protocol table; replies are decoded by packet type. A successfully built frame does not prove device execution.

zh.plain: 此函数把上位机命令封装成 FE/LEN/CMD/PAYLOAD/FF 串口帧。LEN 统计命令字节、payload 和尾字节，不包含 FE 与 LEN 自身。发送前还会依据共享协议表检查命令是否存在、payload 长度是否匹配。
zh.condition: 该图源码描述 _build_command_frame(cmd, payload)；构造仅在 cmd 已知且 payload 长度符合 COMMAND_PAYLOAD_LENGTHS 时成功。
zh.effect: payload 先转换为 bytes；长度由 `1 + len(payload) + 1` 计算；最终拼接 header、LEN、cmd、payload、tail。
zh.failure: 未知命令抛 ValueError；长度不匹配也抛 ValueError，因此不会静默生成错位帧。
zh.recovery: 查看命令表所要求的 payload 长度并修正调用方结构；协议生成器 --check 可验证桌面和固件表的一致性。
zh.unknown: 函数验证帧结构，不证明串口写出、P4 收帧或设备执行成功。
zh.difference: 这里解释的是下行命令的打包器；回包有各自的解码路径与布局。
zh.change: 基线未标记此函数为本次变更。

en.plain: This function packages a host command as an FE/LEN/CMD/PAYLOAD/FF serial frame. LEN counts the command byte, payload, and tail byte; it excludes FE and LEN itself. Before returning a frame, it checks the shared protocol table for a known command and expected payload length.
en.condition: The packet covers _build_command_frame(cmd, payload). Construction succeeds only when cmd is known and payload length matches COMMAND_PAYLOAD_LENGTHS.
en.effect: payload is converted to bytes; LEN is calculated as `1 + len(payload) + 1`; the return value concatenates header, LEN, cmd, payload, and tail.
en.failure: An unknown command or mismatched payload length raises ValueError, so malformed frames are not silently produced.
en.recovery: Check the command table’s required payload size and correct the caller’s structure; the protocol generator --check verifies the desktop and firmware tables agree.
en.unknown: This validates frame structure; it does not prove serial transmission, P4 reception, or device execution.
en.difference: This is the downlink command packer; replies use separate decoding paths and layouts.
en.change: The baseline does not mark this function as changed.

zh.plain: 下行命令子图列出桌面端可以发送给 P4 的命令 ID、payload 长度及编码字段。点击进入后可逐条核对命令如何调用 _build_command_frame，并判断 UI 请求最终对应哪种 wire command。
zh.condition: 通过本图向 commands 子图下钻；该目录由共享协议定义与生成代码约束。
zh.effect: 子图展示命令名、数值与 payload schema，可用于追踪“UI 动作→backend 方法→串口帧”的发送路径。
zh.failure: 命令不存在或字段长度不匹配时，组帧函数拒绝构造帧；命令表与固件不一致会造成解析失败。
zh.recovery: 从协议表查命令定义，运行上位协议生成器的只读 --check，再检查调用方 payload。
zh.unknown: 架构图无法证明每条命令在实机上均被 P4 接受。
zh.difference: 这是发送方向的协议目录；P4 上行反馈位于 Uplink packets 子图。
zh.change: 基线未标记此命令目录为本次变更。

en.plain: The downlink-command subgraph lists command IDs, payload lengths, and encoded fields that the desktop can send to P4. Open it to trace each command through _build_command_frame and identify which wire command represents a UI request.
en.condition: Drill down to the commands subgraph; shared protocol definitions and generated code constrain its contents.
en.effect: The subgraph shows command names, numeric IDs, and payload schemas to follow the path from UI action through backend method to serial frame.
en.failure: An unknown command or a payload-size mismatch makes the frame builder reject the frame; disagreement with firmware can prevent parsing.
en.recovery: Look up the protocol definition, run the upper-protocol generator in read-only --check mode, then inspect the caller payload.
en.unknown: The architecture view cannot prove that P4 accepts every command on hardware.
en.difference: This is the transmit-side catalog; P4 replies appear in the Uplink packets subgraph.
en.change: The baseline does not mark this command catalog as changed.

zh.plain: 上行数据子图描述 P4 回传给桌面端的状态、反馈和应答帧。它与下行命令共用串口，但帧类型、payload 布局和解码逻辑可能不同，不能把命令 payload 长度套用到回包。
zh.condition: 通过本图向 packets 子图下钻，查看接收解析器为各 packet type 定义的字段。
zh.effect: 子图逐种说明回包识别、字段解码和状态更新位置，帮助从 UI 的反馈值反查 P4 数据包。
zh.failure: 未知类型、长度不符或校验失败会使包无法成为可信状态更新；具体拒绝策略应在对应 parser 节点查看。
zh.recovery: 先核对头尾标记、长度与 packet type，再沿对应 parser/校验节点查丢包或状态未更新原因。
zh.unknown: 本图是源码静态结构，不能证明实时串口包未丢失或反馈时延满足控制要求。
zh.difference: 这是 P4 到桌面的接收方向；Commands 是桌面到 P4 的发送方向。
zh.change: 基线未标记此回包目录为本次变更。

en.plain: The uplink-data subgraph describes status, feedback, and acknowledgements sent from P4 to the desktop. It shares the serial link with downlink commands, but packet types, payload layouts, and decoders can differ; command payload lengths must not be applied to replies.
en.condition: Drill down to packets to inspect the fields defined by each receive-side packet type.
en.effect: The subgraph traces packet recognition, field decoding, and state-update locations so a UI value can be followed back to its P4 packet.
en.failure: An unknown type, wrong length, or failed integrity check prevents a packet from becoming a trusted state update; inspect the corresponding parser for exact rejection behavior.
en.recovery: Check header/tail, length, and packet type, then follow that parser and integrity-check node to investigate missing updates.
en.unknown: This is a static source view; it does not prove serial packets are never lost or that feedback latency meets control requirements.
en.difference: This is P4-to-desktop receive traffic; Commands is desktop-to-P4 transmit traffic.
en.change: The baseline does not mark this reply catalog as changed.
